message.content:
Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023.  
A long weekend is defined as a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday and at least one weekend day (Saturday or Sunday).  When a holiday falls on a weekend, the **observed** date (the nearest weekday) is shown in parentheses.

| Long‑Weekend | Holiday(s) | Observed Date(s) | Notes |
|--------------|------------|------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1–2** | New Year’s Day | Jan 2 (Monday) | Jan 1 is Sunday; observed on Monday. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Family Day is the 3rd Monday in February. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| **May 22–24** | Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | Victoria Day is the Monday preceding May 25. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day | Jul 3 (Monday) | Jul 1 is Saturday; observed on Monday. |
| **Sep 4–6** | Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Labour Day is the first Monday in September. |
| **Oct 9–11** | Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Monday) | Thanksgiving is the second Monday in October. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day | Nov 13 (Monday) | Nov 11 is Saturday; observed on Monday. |

### How to use this in your app

1. **Store the dates** in a simple array or database table.  
2. **Mark the holiday names** so users can filter by holiday type.  
3. **Add a flag** for “observed” dates so you can show the actual day people get off work.  
4. **Consider provincial variations** – e.g., Family Day is not a holiday in all provinces, and some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patricks’ Day in Newfoundland & Labrador).  

Feel free to let me know if you need province‑specific long weekends or a more detailed breakdown!
